summary: Iteration 2 — Auth (Emergent Google OAuth) + Calendar history features verified end-to-end. All 33 backend pytest cases passed: auth gating (10 endpoints return 401 without Bearer, 200 with seeded token test_token_1777208185715), /api/auth/me returns user_id+email+name, /api/auth/logout invalidates session (subsequent /me=401), full data isolation between two seeded users (User A's tasks/expenses NOT visible to User B), GET /api/history/2026-04-26 returns aggregated tasks/expenses/habits/health/journal/mood/reminders with correct shape, GET /api/history/active-dates/2026-04 includes today. Frontend (mobile 390x844) verified: unauth visit to / redirects to /login showing Aura brand + tagline + feature list + google-signin-btn; setting localStorage('aura_session_token','test_token_1777208185715') then visiting / loads dashboard with home-greeting + 4 stat cards (no redirect); nav-calendar tab present in BottomNav and navigates to /calendar; calendar renders month grid (30 day cells), cal-prev/cal-next work, cal-day-2026-04-26 tap loads 'Sunday, April 26, 2026' day records with summary chips (0/1 tasks, 0/6 habits, ₹120, 0/8 water) and TASKS+EXPENSES sections; future dates (27-30 Apr) rendered visually dimmed/disabled (no testID emitted for them, confirming disabled state); /settings shows test@example.com email + logout-btn that clears session and redirects to /login. No red screens, no page errors.

issues: Pre-existing cosmetic warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Same as iter1, no functional impact.

Console dev-warning: 'The action REPLACE with payload {name:"login"} was not handled by any navigator. Do you have a route named login?'. Despite the warning, the redirect to /login does work correctly. Likely router.replace is fired before the navigator mounts. Consider router.replace('/login') guard inside useEffect with a small delay or use useRootNavigationState to await readiness.

action_items: (Optional polish) Suppress the dev-only 'REPLACE login route' warning in _layout.tsx by gating router.replace('/login') on useRootNavigationState().key being defined.
(Pre-existing, optional) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~827 lines — getting close to 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth.py, history.py, resources.py) for maintainability.
get_current_user supports both Bearer header and session_token cookie — good cross-platform support.
/api/auth/session sets HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookie AND returns session_token in body — works for both web cookies and AsyncStorage on native. Verified.
Data isolation correctly enforced: every resource query filters by user_id from token. Two-user isolation test passed.
Calendar history aggregation uses regex on created_at/completed_at strings + 'date' field — works because dates are stored as YYYY-MM-DD prefix strings; relies on this convention.

success_rate.backend: 100% (33/33 new auth+calendar tests; iter1 30/30 still valid)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (login redirect, authed home, calendar navigation, day-cell tap, future-date disabled, settings logout)
